newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-RBA's Macfarlane says economic data improving.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-RBA's Macfarlane says economic data improving.

text.p: Reserve Bank of Australia (RBA) Governor Ian Macfarlane said on Tuesday that recent economic data was better than that seen in 1996.
Macfarlane also said after delivering a speech to the Sydney Institute that the outlook for economic activity in 1997 was good.

"Our feeling is that the sort of information that we have received over the last couple of months are somewhat better than in the second half of 1996 when we were making those (interest rate) easings," Macfarlane said in response to questions from the audience.
"The near-term outlook for inflation is very good and the 1997 outlook for economic activity is also good and we are looking for a stronger 1997 than in 1996," he said.
